import sys

sys.setrecursionlimit(10**6)

def solve(n, memo):
    if n == 0:
        return 0
    if n in memo:
        return memo[n]
    lastdif = 10**18
    x = 1
    i = 0
    while abs(x - n) <= lastdif:
        lastdif = abs(x - n)
        x = x * 10 + 1
        i += 1
    x //= 10
    if x > n and x // 10:
        res = min(i + solve(abs(x - n), memo), i - 1 + solve(abs(x // 10 - n), memo))
    else:
        res = i + solve(abs(x - n), memo)
    memo[n] = res
    return res

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    memo = {}
    print(solve(n, memo))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
